Chapter.Heading: Conversion to other group libraries
Chapter.Section:
The Small Groups Library
This library is provided by the &SmallGrp; package.
a pair of integers [x, y] such that SmallGroup(x, y) is isomorphic to SmallClassNrGroup(k, i).
<#Include Label="example_smallgrp">

The Library of Finite Perfect Groups
This library is provided by &GAP; itself.
a pair of integers [x, y] such that PerfectGroup(x, y) is isomorphic to SmallClassNrGroup(k, i).
<#Include Label="example_perfgrp">

The Primitive Permutation Groups Library
This library is provided by the &PrimGrp; package.
a pair of integers [x, y] such that PrimitiveGroup(x, y) is isomorphic to SmallClassNrGroup(k, i).
<#Include Label="example_primgrp">

The Library of Transitive Groups
This library is provided by the &TransGrp; package.
a pair of integers [x, y] such that TransitiveGroup(x, y) is isomorphic to SmallClassNrGroup(k, i).
<#Include Label="example_transgrp">

The ATLAS of Group Representations
This library is provided by the &AtlasRep; package.
a string name such that AtlasGroup(name) is isomorphic to SmallClassNrGroup(k, i).
<#Include Label="example_atlasrep">
